findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: analyze_property · Private data: analyze_property, ask_about_property · Public sink: analyze_property, ask_about_property · Destructive: analyze_property.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: analyze_property · Private data: analyze_property, ask_about_property · Public sink: analyze_property, ask_about_property · Destructive: analyze_property

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
